data.rationale: The proposal gets the Find a Park by State to state selection part right (and the state parameter), but it stops at reviewing the results list and omits the park parameter and the final click on a park's section link (e.g. National Heritage Area), so the procedure is incomplete and an automation built from it would not reach the target page.
